text:
maria: Heads-up — ran into inconsistent env var names across SDKs when rotating API keys during onboarding for a customer. Quick thread to align on best practice? Example: Ruby uses REDWOOD_API_KEY, JS uses REDWOOD_KEY, Go uses RW_API_TOKEN. :grimacing:

alex: Ugh. That's been causing dev friction. We should standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY and document fallback support for older names.

sam: Agree. Also need to clarify org/project scoping. Right now CLI looks for RW_ORG_ID but SDKs use REDWOOD_ORG. Confusing for repo setups.

jen: Propose: env vars: REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_ORG, REDWOOD_PROJECT (optional). SDKs should support legacy names for 6 months and log a deprecation warning.

maria: Rotation flow question: what's the recommended approach for zero-downtime rotate with Dedicated? Customer wants rotating creds every 24h. Any SDK retry/backoff concerns?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for dedicated-rotator v2 — includes key-rotation endpoint /v1/keys/rotate

alex: For zero-downtime: create new key via Admin API, update config in secret store, then update service to read new key and reload. SDKs should pick up env var reload on SIGHUP or offer a reload() call.

sam: SDK parity item: JS/py have auto-reload, Go doesn't. We need an issue to add WatchEnv or Reload function to Go SDK.

jen: Also add docs snippet for rotation automation using Vault + rolling restart template. Example script: ```bash
# create new key
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"scope":"org:123"}' | jq -r .key > /tmp/new.key
# update vault
vault kv put secret/redwood api_key=@/tmp/new.key
# rollout
kubectl rollout restart deploy/my-app
```

maria: :thumbsup: Can we add log message when SDK sees legacy var and when rotation happened? For audit we need timestamped events.

alex: Yes — emit `redwood.sdk.auth=legacy_var_used` and `redwood.sdk.auth=rotated` metrics/traces. Add to router/tracing.

jen: I'll open a GH issue for standard env names + migration plan and another for Go SDK reload. Assigning to @sam and @alex.

sam: On it. Also let's pick TTL for legacy support: 180 days. We should auto-suggest env var name in error messages.

maria: Thanks — this will reduce onboarding friction a lot. Any objections to the naming choice?

alex: None from infra. Go ahead. :rocket:
